_overrides_comment: avalanche@3.x SDK fully removed 2026-05-15 — replaced with Validator/src/avalanche/avalanche-shim.ts to drop axios@0.21 + ws@7 + bn.js@5.2.1 transitives. See task #11. @noble/hashes scoped overrides 2026-05-16 — hardhat-internal ethereum-cryptography@2.2.1 + @scure/bip32 expect v1.4 API (`_assert.default.bool`, `_assert.bytes` named export); v1.8 renamed both. v1.4 satisfies both old API + new named exports. Scoped to avoid downgrading viem which already runs cleanly on v1.8 since it doesn't use the _assert module. chalk@^4.1.2 global override 2026-05-28 — the global ansi-styles@^5.2.0 override above hoists v5 to all consumers, but solidity-coverage's bundled chalk@2.4.2 (its lockfile pin via hardhat-toolbox > solidity-coverage > chalk@^2.4.2) calls `Object.keys(ansiStyles.color.ansi)` at load time, which exists in ansi-styles v3 but was removed by v5's restructure → crash on every hardhat invocation. Upgrading the whole workspace's chalk to v4.1.2 fixes it: chalk@4 is the last major version with full CommonJS support (chalk@5+ went ESM-only and would break every workspace's `require('chalk')` site), ships its own ansi-styles@^4 internally that's API-stable across the v5 transitives, and is a drop-in for chalk@2's chained-property API (`chalk.bold.green('x')`). Nested override syntax (`solidity-coverage > chalk`) only works for direct deps; solidity-coverage is a hardhat-toolbox transitive so the global pin is the correct npm-overrides shape here.
